_about: Charles Darwin (1809-1882), the rest of his books beside the two the adler shelf already holds (On the Origin of Species, 1st edition, PG 1228; The Descent of Man, PG 2300), which are not repeated here. Project Gutenberg etexts: the Beagle journal in its 1845 second edition (PG 944); the geology of the voyage (Coral Reefs, Volcanic Islands, Geological Observations on South America); the barnacle monographs for the Ray Society (1851, 1854); The Variation of Animals and Plants under Domestication; The Expression of the Emotions; the botanical books (Climbing Plants, Insectivorous Plants, Cross and Self-Fertilisation, Different Forms of Flowers, The Power of Movement in Plants); The Formation of Vegetable Mould through the Action of Worms; the Autobiography; Life and Letters and More Letters, ed. Francis Darwin; and The Foundations of the Origin of Species, the essays of 1842 and 1844 (ed. Francis Darwin, 1909). Not taken: the later Origin editions (PG 2009, 22764, 8205, 21153) and other witnesses of the Beagle journal (PG 3704, 6951), as further witnesses of texts already held; the Zoology of the Beagle volumes, written by Owen, Waterhouse, Gould, Jenyns and Bell under his editorship. US public domain. No uids minted.
